{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
{{Quote|To fasten your restraint, use the yellow strap to pull the belt out from the right side of the seat, and snap the belt into the buckle on your left.|[[Aly San San/Legends|Aly San San]] delivering flight safety instructions|<ref name="Star Tours: The Adventures Continue">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>}}
A '''restraint harness''', also called '''restraint''', '''restraint belt''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> or '''seatbelt''', was a safety feature incorporated into [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] and ground vehicles. It was designed with the intention of keeping the occupants of the craft safe in the event of a crash. The transport ships used by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency, the [[StarSpeeder 1000]] and its upgrade the [[StarSpeeder 3000]], were all equipped with individual restraints for every seat. Luke Skywalker's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] also included a restraint, which protected him during a crash landing on [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
In [[Roan Novachez]]'s second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] at the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he and several other students involved in a food fight were required to take a field trip to observe the workings of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. When they visited there, the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] they used were equipped with seatbelts, which [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] required them to fasten for safety.
{{Noncanonend}}
